summary: Steel Arkansas Forestry Commission tower beside Highway 15 near Pansy, Cleveland County; the only source found is a 1942 survey, with no build date or later record.

facts.design: All-steel tower with an enclosed cabin at the top

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey described the tower and its station in 1942, so it stood by then; no build date is given

evidence.supports: tower is in Cleveland County and belongs to the Arkansas Forestry Commission
evidence.quote: Arkansas - Cleveland County - Arkansas Forestry Commission

evidence.supports: directory name is provisional, shown with a question mark
tower is Unit 4, No. 6 of the Arkansas Forestry Commission
site is on state-owned land beside State Highway 15, 1.35 miles north of Pansy
evidence.quote: THIS INTERSECTION STATION IS LOCATED ON STATE OWNED LAND, ON THE W SIDE OF STATE HIGHWAY 15, 1.35 MILES N OF PANSY

evidence.supports: about 100 feet high, all steel, enclosed cabin at the top
evidence.quote: IT IS ABOUT 100 FEET HIGH, IS OF ALL STEEL CONSTRUCTION, AND HAS AN ENCLOSED CABIN AT THE TOP.

evidence.supports: tower stands about 65 feet west of the highway center line
evidence.quote: IT IS 65 FEET W OF THE CENTER LINE OF STATE HIGHWAY 15
DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1942 (FBQ)

sources.title: (Pansy ?) lookout tower, quoting a National Geodetic Survey station description

notes_for_editor: One source only: a directory page quoting a 1942 NGS datasheet (DL1256). The name is provisional. Two WebSearch queries found no other record of a Pansy or Cleveland County tower. A 1955 Arkansas Forestry and Parks Commission operations map held by the Arkansas State Archives, listed in one search result, may show it; not checked. Status and site condition unknown. Brief height 30.5 m matches the NGS 'about 100 feet'; no correction proposed.
